data.note: The task is queued on the durable runtime and runs to completion server-side. Poll `gsk task status sb_task_run::e601071e-2aa2-4201-9628-8f44a5615cef::4db38e39d8ed7d73` every 15-60s (simple tasks finish in under a minute; big generations take 5-30 min) until it reports a terminal state — do NOT re-run this submit command; an identical resubmit converges on this same run. Pass `--wait true` only when you deliberately need the legacy blocking call (then set your shell timeout to 1800000 ms). run_id is YOUR internal handle (status/stop); do not show it to the user. task_url is the user-facing task page — hand THAT to the user to click/track; it is not a query API.
